none: PAS NLM-7AE561: Roman Coin: radiate of Claudius II from Kirmington
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP C CLA]VDIVS AVG ; R/ FID[ES EXER]CI

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Claudius II (268-270), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [IMP C CLA]VDIVS AVG. Reverse description: Fides Militum standing facing, head right, holding two standards, that in the left hand transverse. Reverse inscription: FID[ES EXER]CI. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear volume 3 page 400 no. 11334. Diameter: 18.1mm, Weight: 3.00gms, die axis: 12
